chunks: He said: Abul Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad - may Allah bless him with mercy - reported to me from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:

O assembly of those who have believed with their tongues while faith has not reached their hearts! Do not pursue the faults of the believers, and do not revile the Muslims. For indeed, whoever pursues the faults of the believers, Allah will pursue his faults; and when Allah pursues his faults, He will expose him in the innermost part of his house.

key_terms.تَتَبُّع: To pursue, investigate, or search for something deliberately; implies active effort to uncover
key_terms.عَوْرَات: Faults, private matters, or vulnerabilities that should be concealed; from the same root as awrah (nakedness/shame)
key_terms.مَعْشَر: An assembly or group of people addressed collectively; used here as a vocative to address a specific category

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet Muhammad say about exposing the faults of believers in Islam?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition, narrated through Imam al-Sadiq (AS), records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addressing those whose faith is superficial - professing Islam verbally but lacking inner conviction. He commands them not to seek out the private faults of believers nor disparage Muslims, warning that Allah will reciprocally expose the faults of anyone who does so, even within the privacy of their own home. This teaching was delivered in Medina to address the behavior of those whose outward conformity masked inward deficiency in faith.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
